rules: Workers must not edit this file. Only the orchestrator may set passes from false to true after a matching passing VerificationRecord exists and must record accepted_run_id, accepted_verification_sha256, accepted_at, and accepted_by. Descriptions and steps are immutable after Gate 0.

features.description: A real authenticated Codex/Luna worker creates and commits exactly one authorized nonce file, and the same run is linked through immutable authorization, observed execution, deterministic verification, and separate orchestrator acceptance.
steps: Committed mission/task/fleet evidence authorizes Codex economy gpt-5.6-luna at medium effort and only smoke/nonce.txt
The real worker writes exact nonce 5818a92a-4798-4c29-832f-81e71012bece and makes one commit containing only smoke/nonce.txt
The strict terminal receipt links the immutable spec, records completed execution, exact Git-visible change, and passing one-file scope
Run-specific verification executes the committed checks and writes a passing immutable VerificationRecord with no acceptance fields
The orchestrator separately accepts that exact VerificationRecord and mission-wide worker verification passes
